name: Larry Payne
reason: Health rule: his own site (samata.com, Samata International) presents him as a 'back specialist' and founding figure of yoga therapy, and his main offers are private Yoga Therapy Rx sessions promising to 'eliminate pain' and 'improve mental health', senior yoga teacher training and books such as Yoga Rx and Yoga Therapy & Integrative Medicine; the work is mainly therapeutic and condition-led, so little would pass the strict health-claim rule.
